name: South Ossetia
officialName: Republic of South Ossetia – the State of Alania
facts: Russia and a few other UN member states

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, red and yellow.
flag.symbolism: The colours are traditionally said to represent moral purity (white), courage (red) and wealth and prosperity (yellow).

hook: South Ossetia is a plain white-red-yellow tricolour from top to bottom, with no emblem at all.
trivia: The flag has the same design as that of North Ossetia–Alania, a republic of Russia on the other side of the Caucasus.
Russia recognised South Ossetia's independence in August 2008, after the Russo-Georgian War.
